maria: heads-up — started Llama4x -> Gemma conversion and ran into a weird embedding offset when we apply the phaseband rotary scaling :thinking:
akash: details? what offset magnitude are we seeing?
maria: ~3-6 tokens into the context embeddings the values diverge vs reference, looks like an ordering problem not a simple scale. repro on juno GPU.
leo: could be embed projection row/col order. Gemma exports proj as (out, in) but our loader assumes (in, out).
sofia: that matches older head-order bugs. do you see the same when loading Qwen variants?
maria: tried with Qwen-converted weights — smaller drift, but still systematic. Qwen->Gemma conversion flips a stride in the proj layout in our converter.
james: pinging the conv script owners @leo — can you paste the tiny repro?
leo: quick check I ran:
```python
# repro snippet
W = torch.load('proj.pt')  # shape (3072, 4096)
# our loader expects row-major, Gemma export was col-major
W2 = W.t().contiguous()
# quick compare
print((W2 - reference).abs().mean())
```
maria: exact. transpose fixes the mean absolute diff to ~1e-6. without it we see ~0.02 which aligns with the quality drop.
ci-bot: conversion-run 1745556672 finished — 1 failed test: embed-order-check (see artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/1745556672)
sofia: tokenizer note — during the convert we also noticed BPE merges causing a sentinel collision on Gemma's vocab (U+FEFF entries). could that shift token ids and appear like an embed offset?
akash: good catch. check: token id map should be identity except for <unk>/<pad>. any UID reassignments?
maria: mapped token ids looked OK, but there were sparse entries at high indices which our embedding table assumed contiguous. padding in the saved embedding tensor had 2 extra rows — seems like off-by-two index shift.
leo: so two independent issues: proj transpose + embedding tensor padding. explains why Qwen conversion (no pad rows) had lower drift.
james: what's impact on quantization runs? we saw a 1.8% rouge drop in int4 for the failing conversion.
maria: after transpose + remove-pad rows, int4/run regressed back to baseline. I'll open a PR to fix converter and add a unit that asserts embedding shape == vocab_size.
sofia: also add a rotary unit test: sample pairwise cos similarities before/after conversion for first 8 positions — catches phaseband misapply.
eva: can we add a quick checklist for new model onboarding: 1) vocab-size vs emb-shape; 2) proj order assert; 3) rotary-phaseband parity; 4) run small int4 smoke suite?
akash: yes — let's put it in onboarding.md and make it required for conversions.
maria: PR ready in my fork, will link after CI passes. thanks all :thumbsup:
